testsuite.name: gg.rsmod.plugins.content.mechanics.death.PvpDeathBreakablesTests

testcase.name: N247 above level 20 a fire cape or defender breaks, Void is lost for coins - OSRS broken table
PvM deaths and protected defenders are untouched
a used amulet of the damned turns to dust on any death, the full one does not
a carried kit is never lost on a wilderness death - it goes to the victim's gravestone
protected revenant weapons still drop their stored ether
ornamented items without the base plus kit rule keep the default death handling
every breakable item breaks in place and pays exactly its sourced repair cost
wilderness death breaks an inventory Avernic defender in place and pays the repair cost once
an equipped Avernic defender is unequipped and kept broken in the inventory
a lost charged slayer helmet drops its stored Summoning scrolls to the killer, the screen shows them
owner Q14 conversions - killer loot, victim gravestone share and imbue refund for the whole set
an unprotected serpentine helm drops uncharged with its scales
granite maul (or) without a Grand Exchange price gives nothing instead of a wrong amount
forBroken round-trips every breakable's broken id back to its Breakable, and rejects anything else
a charged or full powered staff drops as its uncharged id on an unprotected wilderness death, charges lost
every kitted item drops its plain item to the killer and sends its kit to the victim's gravestone
lost revenant bows - Craw's activation disappears, Webweaver's goes to the killer
